purpose: freeze the publication-selected Blum 2019 B3 deterministic ERK model and reproduce a source-native latent trajectory before any Bio Chi eigenspectrum or scalar construction is opened

publication_model_selection.role: publication-selected final network after held-out pulse validation and independent HSPG perturbation

primary_reproduction_protocol.input_rule: sustained from t=0 throughout the 0 to 180 minute source trajectory
primary_reproduction_protocol.times_minutes: exact source sim_times.txt, 0 to 178 in 2 minute increments
primary_reproduction_protocol.initial_state_rule: source-native initial_states_B3 values using the primary vector's fgfr_init_mean, nfb_init, and h_init_mean
primary_reproduction_protocol.solver: scipy.integrate.solve_ivp(method='BDF', rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-10) as an independent deterministic ODE reproduction of the source CVODE model
primary_reproduction_protocol.comparison: all 15 states at all 91 source timepoints
primary_reproduction_protocol.source_precision_note: source latent-state text is rounded ASCII output, so byte-level numeric equality is not required

stoichiometric_dynamic_subspace_rule_for.reason: reaction-network conservation laws create exact or numerical zero directions that are constraints rather than independent dynamical stability modes
stoichiometric_dynamic_subspace_rule_for.construction: form the 15x16 reaction stoichiometric matrix S in source state/reaction order; compute an orthonormal basis Q for col(S); analyze J_reduced = Q^T J Q
stoichiometric_dynamic_subspace_rule_for.basis_invariance_requirement: future modal conclusions must be invariant to orthonormal basis choice within the same stoichiometric column space

next_if_reproduction_passes: freeze and execute generator-first stoichiometric-subspace modal transport at source-defined sustained FGF2 inputs, with scalar refusal allowed
next_if_reproduction_fails: preserve failure, debug only mechanical equation/order/parameter mapping errors, and do not open ERK spectra until native reproduction is resolved

changed: primary_reproduction_protocol source time endpoint from 180 to 178 minutes
